comments.text: Stored secrets are restored by slice index, not by provider name. If the submitted providers list is in a different order, or a provider was removed/inserted (e.g. the new provider is added at the front, or one in the middle is deleted), provider i gets the client secret of whatever provider was previously at index i. That silently misconfigures providers and, worse, sends one provider's client secret to another provider's token endpoint (secret leak to a third party). Match stored configs by `Name` (e.g. build a map from the cloned slice) and only restore a secret for the same provider.

`encoding/json/v2` is an experimental package (only available behind GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2) and has different default semantics from encoding/json (e.g. case-sensitive field matching, different merge behavior), which the rest of the codebase uses. Use `encoding/json` here. Also please add tests covering adding, reordering and removing providers to show secrets stay attached to the right provider.
